title: From 4-Hour Job Hunt to 30 Minutes | vitalii.no
description:
How an Edge Function that scores every job listing against my CV cut my daily job search from four hours to under thirty minutes.

Every day, 500 to 800 job listings from FINN.no, NAV.no, and LinkedIn flooded my feeds. Sorting through them by hand for a genuine fit was a brutal four-hour grind, and it wasn't just slow — it introduced subjective bias, caused burnout, and let good opportunities slip through unnoticed.

I built a job_analyzer Deno Edge Function on Supabase. It reads each job description alongside an anonymized CV and runs it through an AI-powered "Vibe & Fit Scanner" that outputs a structured fit score, pros and cons, key tasks, and workplace tone. For batch runs of ten or more jobs, a GitHub Actions workflow takes over so the analysis never hits an Edge Function timeout or API rate limit.

Daily search time plummeted from four-plus hours to under thirty minutes — a 90 percent reduction in time wasted on irrelevant listings, with hot matches (fit score 50+) flagged for immediate action.
